$comment: Single source of truth for which skill packages ship to agents. Consumers: synap-backend GET /skills/system (serves to text agents), synap-cli skills-installer.ts (writes ~/.claude/skills) + scripts/sync-skills.sh (published-tarball mirror). 'baseline' = always-on packages (core knowledge, injected by tool-trigger / the IS baseline). 'workflow' = intent-triggered packages (launched on user intent, e.g. onboarding / company setup). Delivered-to-disk set = baseline + workflow. NOTE: the IS baseline sync intentionally consumes ONLY 'baseline' — workflow skills must not be always-on. Adding a new deliverable skill = one line here.
